initialExam.title: BARC OCES/DGFS 2026
initialExam.description: BARC recruits Scientific Officers through OCES (Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates & Science Postgraduates) and DGFS (DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme) for nuclear research and engineering.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech with 60% marks or M.Sc in Physics/Chemistry/Biosciences with 60% marks. Valid GATE score or qualify BARC online screening test.
initialExam.ageLimit: 26 years for OCES, 28 years for DGFS
initialExam.syllabus: Based on GATE syllabus of respective engineering/science discipline. Interview covers core subject knowledge and aptitude.
initialExam.examPattern: GATE score based shortlisting OR BARC online screening test (MCQ, 2 hours) → Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: GATE Score / Screening Test → Interview (May-June 2026) → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Scientific Officer in BARC for nuclear research, reactor engineering, health physics, and allied fields
initialExam.careerGrowth: Scientific Officer C → SO D → SO E → SO F → SO G → SO H → Outstanding Scientist → Distinguished Scientist.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit barc.gov.in/careers 2. Register 3. Apply online 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 10 (Group A, 7th CPC). Stipend during training: ₹74,000/month

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Subsidized housing, LTC, Children education allowance, Superannuation benefits

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years. DGFS: 28 years max
